author: bardic-inspiration
name: Spy in the Cellar
summary: A cult spy and two cultists listen through the floor of the Greencheck from a hidden cellar nook.

parts.text: Behind the last rack of barrels, a gap in the bricks breathes lamplight. Three figures crouch around a copper funnel pressed to the ceiling, scribbling on wax tablets.

The {ref:creature/spy} is listening for anyone asking about the cult. It wants to escape with its notes, not to fight: it orders the {ref:creature/cultist}s to hold the gap and runs for the drain in the Ale Cellar. If caught, it trades the name of Testmore Keep for its life.
